classLaw: the attempt class exists only where an act can be launched and fail (throws, takings, reachings-for); non-taking deeds have no attempt siblings — a spoken intimidation IS the deed (#269 scores the speaking)
conscience: an attempt appends to #269's ledger with its witness set and moves morale at attempt weight whether or not anyone saw it — the RDR2 rule: you know what you tried to do
evidence: a witnessed attempt enters #272's flow as an attempt: it grounds reports and findings, but the wanted level reads from the attempt row, not the completed deed's; repeated attempts are read by #272's history rule
launchThreshold: an attempt exists only after the act's own gate is passed and the act launched (for theft: the confirmed throw, #268/#347). Declined prompts, pre-launch refusals (#351), and closed menus are NOT attempts — #350's pipeline is what makes the line checkable
note: The seed row (attempted theft, -3) already lives in #269's table with its addendum note; this fragment states the class the row belongs to. Rows land in #269's file only (STAGING step 2).
reputationFence: attempts never appear in #270's tallies on their own; a witnessed AND reported attempt enters a group's belief as an attempt at attempt weight; an unreported attempt is invisible to every group
